name: Leakage-safe Cannabis diagnostic split policy
goal: Prevent scientific figures, serial images, video frames, clones, plants, and near-duplicates from leaking across train, validation, and test sets.
hardRules: Every derivative crop from one original image stays in one split.
Every panel from one scientific composite figure stays in one split unless the entire source is reference-only.
All frames from one video stay in one split.
Serial photographs of the same plant stay in one split.
Clonal siblings from the same experimental treatment should stay together when treatment identity could leak the diagnosis.
Exact SHA-256 duplicates and perceptual near-duplicates may not occur in different splits.
Cross-crop transfer data may not enter the Cannabis validation or test set.
Rights-restricted, symptom-only, mechanistically ambiguous, or unresolved samples are excluded or reference-only, not silently promoted to training ground truth.
claimPolicy: Do not publish a Cannabis diagnostic accuracy number unless the held-out test set contains Cannabis/hemp samples from independent source groups and the split has passed duplicate and provenance audits.
